# Landflow

> Landflow is a low-code workflow platform modelled on n8n, where every node is a plugin written in TypeScript, Python or Go and discovered over HTTP, gRPC or a message broker. These are its docs: building flows and agents, connecting tools, running and operating the host, and the API, configuration and plugin protocol references.

## Start here

- [Landflow platform guide](/llms-full.txt#platform-readme-md): The platform guide: one page per area for people, each with a skill that tells Claude how to do the same job.
- [Platform overview](/llms-full.txt#platform-overview-md): The whole platform on one page: the processes, one run from trigger to Run Trace, where data lives, who may do what.
- [Agents](/llms-full.txt#platform-agents-md): What a Landflow agent is, where it runs, how a flow calls it, and the routes that make, publish and chat with one.
- [Agent best practices](/llms-full.txt#platform-agent-best-practices-md): What to follow when building an agent in Landflow, by hand or through Spotlight.
- [Connect your harness](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/connect-your-harness.md): Connect a coding tool (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, VS Code, any MCP client) to Landflow with /connect.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): How Landflow is put together: the processes, what each owns, how a run moves through them and where the code is.

## Build

- [Building and debugging a flow](/llms-full.txt#features-editor-md): The editor: canvas, node creator, runs, pinned data, debugging, versions and templates; importing from n8n and Flowise.
- [Engine](/llms-full.txt#features-engine-md): The engine: data model, durable runtime, queue mode and HA, triggers, flow nodes, rate limits and the Code node.
- [Composite nodes](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/composites.md): Composite nodes: canvas groups typed by a contract (slots, rules, ports), checked in the editor and run as one step.
- [AI agents](/llms-full.txt#features-ai-md): AI Agent and its sub-nodes, AI Judge, hosted chat and widget, RAG, guardrails, evaluations and MCP.
- [Agents (Preview)](/llms-full.txt#agents-md): Standalone agents: personas, skills, capabilities, channels, schedules, memory, knowledge, testing and publishing.
- [Agent teams](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/agent-teams.md): Agent teams: a lead, reporting lines and reviewers, the org chart, budgets and publishing.
- [Team notebook](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/team-notebook.md): The team notebook: shared notes members write while they work, search by meaning, disputes and promotion.
- [Team templates](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/templates.md): Team templates: a team, its agents and its flow saved as one template and created again with fresh ids.
- [Editor assistant](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/assistant.md): The editor assistant: after-run suggestions and Spotlight, the chat that builds, fixes and publishes flows and agents.
- [Files and binary data](/llms-full.txt#features-files-md): Files and binary data: items carry file references, never bytes, so files of any size move through a flow.
- [Settings, variables, data tables and insights](/llms-full.txt#features-settings-and-data-md): Settings, variables, data tables and insights.
- [Event subscriptions](/llms-full.txt#features-event-subscriptions-md): Event subscriptions: signed POSTs of a project's run events to a URL.
- [Git sync](/llms-full.txt#features-git-sync-md): Git sync: workflows as files you review and version in Git, shared with the CLI.
- [Practices](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/practices.md): Practices: rules in the brain that every connected agent follows, each approved by a person.
- [Projects and goals](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/projects-and-goals.md): Projects and goals: the company mission, the goal tree, the goals a project serves and the project brief.
- [Second brain: learning from how Landflow is used](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/second-brain.md): The second brain: the usage ledger, detectors, the Suggestions inbox, facts and the Brain page.
- [Work events and the daily briefing](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/work-and-briefings.md): Work events from people's own tools and the daily briefing each person gets back.
- [Run Trace](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/run-trace.md): Run Trace: each run's journal told so a person can follow it, with the Story, Trace, Team, Spend and Report screens.
- [The approval inbox](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/approval-inbox.md): The approval inbox: production approvals that wait for a person in Needs you, with expiry and one claim behind every door.
- [Alert triage and Landfall war rooms](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/triage.md): Alert triage and Landfall war rooms: the triage, Landfall and threat-intel plugins and their flows.
- [Runbooks from Landfall war rooms](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/runbooks.md): Runbooks made from closed Landfall war rooms, found by alert kind.
- [Landflow on a phone](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/mobile.md): How Landflow's screens work below 768 px: the tab bar, full-screen pages, touch and type.

- [Marketplace](/llms-full.txt#marketplace-md): The Marketplace: Claude Code plugin marketplaces as agents, skills, node plugins and flows; flow share pages.
- [Writing plugins](/llms-full.txt#plugins-md): Writing plugins: the node interface, autodiscovery and branding.
- [Plan: one plugin, every transport, and MCP](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/transports.md): Transports: HTTP, gRPC, brokers, Auto, the claim check and MCP faces for one plugin.

- [agentgateway in Landflow: what we verified](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/mcp-gateway.md): agentgateway in Landflow: sync, identity and tokens, as verified.
- [The LLM gateway (LiteLLM)](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/llm-gateway.md): The LLM gateway (LiteLLM): models, caps, spend by project, agent, person and model, and the AI page.
- [The landflow-brain Claude Code mod](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/landflow-brain-mod.md): The landflow-brain Claude Code mod: your own session as a held, private work event, reviewed before it is sent.
- [Web Search](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/web-search.md): Web Search: SearXNG, Brave Search and Tavily as an agent tool.
- [Writing node plugins with the SDKs](/llms-full.txt#platform-sdk-readme-md): Writing node plugins with the TypeScript, Python and Go SDKs.
- [What a plugin can do](/llms-full.txt#platform-sdk-capabilities-md): Everything a node plugin can use, with a sample and what each SDK supports.
- [Build a plugin in TypeScript](/llms-full.txt#platform-sdk-typescript-md): Build a plugin in TypeScript: an action with a credential, two outputs and a poll trigger.
- [Build a plugin in Python](/llms-full.txt#platform-sdk-python-md): Build a plugin in Python: an action with a credential, two outputs and a poll trigger.
- [Build a plugin in Go](/llms-full.txt#platform-sdk-go-md): Build a plugin in Go: an action with a credential, two outputs and a poll trigger.

- [Landflow on Kubernetes](/llms-full.txt#platform-kubernetes-md): Landflow on Kubernetes: what runs in the cluster, how the pieces connect and how the manifests fit.
- [The host's layers](/llms-full.txt#platform-server-layers-md): The host's layers from the request down to the database, and one new route followed through them.
- [Authentication](/llms-full.txt#features-authentication-md): Authentication: users, roles, projects, API keys, OIDC, SAML and SCIM.
- [Audit log and governance](/llms-full.txt#features-audit-and-governance-md): The audit log and governance: who did what, retention, export and the rules around changes.
- [External secrets and environments](/llms-full.txt#features-secrets-and-environments-md): External secrets and environments: credentials that read from a secret store at run time.
- [Observability](/llms-full.txt#features-observability-md): Observability in the product: one trace per execution, metrics and logs.
- [Observability](https://github.com/landfalls-ai/landflow/blob/main/docs/observability.md): The observability contract: OpenTelemetry spans, metrics, logs and token and cost tracking.
- [Postgres write queue](/llms-full.txt#features-postgres-write-queue-md): Postgres mode's write queue: the spool, the blocked state, recovery and metrics.

## Reference

- [HTTP API](/llms-full.txt#reference-api-md): The HTTP API: every route under /api, grouped by area.
- [Configuration](/llms-full.txt#reference-configuration-md): Configuration: every environment variable, its default and what it does.
- [Landflow Plugin Protocol — `landflow.plugin/v1`](/llms-full.txt#protocol-md): The Landflow plugin protocol (landflow.plugin/v1): descriptors, execution, credentials, binary data and transports.
- [CLI](/llms-full.txt#features-cli-md): The landflow command line: workflows, runs, executions, data tables, variables, Git sync and your AI spend.
